data.name: Deliver Touch Spells
data.description: You can use your poppet to deliver touch spells. After casting a touch spell, as a full-round action, you can designate a target and stab a pin into your poppet, delivering the spell as a ranged touch attack. The target must be within range of your aura of desecration ability.
